name: Tall Bear 23
author: aadium
description: Gradient rounded orange form that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, border becomes 2px solid #ff5900, background changes from #ff5900 to #00000000, text color changes from #ff5900 to #ff5900. On focus, border becomes 1px solid #66da4300, border-bottom becomes 1px solid #ff5900, background-color changes from transparent to transparent.

    <textarea class="textarea" placeholder="Enter message"></textarea>
    <center><button class="button">Submit</button></center>
</form>
